svg.title: Omega × ASI
svg.desc: Open with the ELI16 executive summary, then the helicopter view and all fifteen module responsibilities before implementation details. M1.1 proved independent storage substitution and separate owner commits. M1.2 connected the real native Hive caller. M2 adds only C1 EpisodicMemory and C2 BeliefRevision, including actual guarded native PLN revision and one real Hive episode scenario. This is a bounded engineering integration, not a general reasoning agent or production system. Suggested delivery: 35–40 minutes through slide 30; eight appendices support questions. Current evidence is the final clean d9e7577 run, recorded in unchanged-code descendant f0cee24. Rebuilding this presentation does not rerun integrations.
svg.text: From replaceable modules to private memory and guarded native revision
Architecture and evidence • 16 October 2026 • supported local scope
OMEGA × ASI / THROUGH M2 / M2 evidence f0cee24 · tested d9e7577
